description: Read one page: its markdown `body`, its `state`, what links to it (`links_here` - who depends on it, which is what matters before you change something) and what it links to. Address it by id, or by `path` within a named `wiki`. ALWAYS read a page before writing to it: the `base_revision` it returns is what update_page requires, and a write against a stale one is refused rather than silently overwriting whoever got there first. `viewing_draft` true means what you are reading is NOT what readers see. `watchers` is how many people will be told when you publish - check it before a significant change.

page.description: page is the page's id or its full path within the wiki.

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

wiki.description:
wiki is the wiki the page is in - its id or slug. Required when addressing
 a page by path; optional when `page` is an id.

name: get_page

baseRevision.description:
base_revision is the revision this body came from. Pass it back as
 base_revision on update_page - a write against a superseded revision is
 refused rather than silently overwriting whoever got there first.

body.description:
body is the markdown you are reading: the published version for a reader,
 the newest version for someone who can edit.

linksHere.description:
links_here is the pages that link TO this one - who depends on it, which is
 the half that matters before you change something.

linksTo.description: links_to is the pages this one links to.

parent.description: parent is the id of the page above it; empty for the wiki's root.

path.description: path is the page's full path within its wiki, e.g. "handbook/day-one".

restricted.description:
restricted is true when this page sits in a subtree that is fenced off to
 named people - you can see it, so you are one of them.

state.description:
state is one of: draft, awaiting_approval, published,
 published_draft_changes, archived, deletion_scheduled.

publishedAt.description: published_at is when the live version went out (YYYY-MM-DD), empty if never.

publishedRevision.description:
published_revision is the revision readers currently see; 0 when nothing
 has been published.

url.description: url is the page's canonical link.

viewingDraft.description: viewing_draft is true when this body is NOT what readers see.

watchers.description:
watchers is how many people are watching this page. Check it before
 publishing a significant change - it should be a deliberate act.

title: Get page
